title: pulicaria villosa
intro: Pulicaria villosa, commonly known as Egyptian fleabane, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pulicaria villosa include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
